name: Brightness, contrast, saturation on raw channels
plain: Packs that pretend the first channels are RGB. PPFN and Apt_Preset centre on 0.5 and use Rec.601 luma weights on channels 0,1,2, then reassemble exactly 4 channels. DenRakEiw centres on each channel's own mean and scales brightness by 0.5. None of this corresponds to image colour without a format-specific matrix.
math:
PPFN: c′=(c−0.5)·contrast+0.5+(brightness−1); gray=.299r+.587g+.114b; c″=(c′−gray)·sat+gray; ·2^exposure; channel 3 untouched
DenRakEiw: brightness: x+0.5b; contrast: (x−μ)·k+μ with μ per channel; hue via kornia HSV on 0..1 rescaled channels

props.params: brightness=1, contrast=1, saturation=1, exposure=0, alpha_sharpen=0, high_pass_radius=0

label: from code
surprise: PPFN slices r,g,b,a then torch.cat (nodes.py:506,521), so a 16-channel latent silently comes back with only 4 channels.
